messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: how can I make a MDS analysis?
parts:
If your mds is called mds and your data, data, then you can do something like:

pts <- mds$points
colnames(pts) <- paste("M", 1:ncol(pts), sep="")
ord <- cbind(data, pts)

and then plot ord.

Hadley
